operator_intent_summary: Make the OneTime parent/student invite journey feel like a real launch experience, not a Codex test harness: no test labels, no BNA bleed, no fallback-code-first workflow, clear warm parent copy, and no live resend until the exact live student identity is confirmed.
raw_quotes: get everything ready for a live student a 100% Live email to me
there should be nothing about BNA
there is no like fall back classroom password
remove unnecessary link back to the main website
out_of_scope: No live email resend until the exact live student display name is supplied.
No use of BNA school student records as OneTime live student records unless explicitly named for this OneTime invite.

observed: Live invite route defaults studentName to TEST One Time Student.
Live invite route adds TEST and codex-test tags and notes.
Parent setup success links include OneTime public home.
Member library and classroom pages present fallback access code details in normal no-code state.
Member library and classroom base palettes still use teal/cream colors that conflict with the black/yellow OneTime rule.
known_blockers: Exact live student display name remains unknown.

expanded_phrases.million-dollar: Concrete launch standard: no test labels, no cross-brand flashes, compact mobile-safe first screen, all visible controls either work or are removed/hidden, copy sounds parent-facing, and proof exists.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: The normal user path must be production-mode by default, with test/smoke behavior only behind an explicit flag.
expanded_phrases.professional: Email copy must sound like a real parent welcome from OneTime/Rabbi voice, not a dry system notification.
expanded_phrases.working: Every visible action in the touched path has a handler, valid URL, or is hidden until support context requires it.
expanded_phrases.clean: The touched launch path has only role-relevant controls, no unnecessary public-site links, no diagnostic/test language, and compact spacing on mobile.
expanded_phrases.test: Production invites must not write TEST tags, codex-test tags, TEST student names, or walkthrough-only notes.
expanded_phrases.BNA bleed: OneTime pages, emails, and loading states must not show Academy names, BNA URLs, BNA helper copy, or BNA palette defaults.
expanded_phrases.fallback classroom password: Fallback code/password entry is support-only, hidden by default, and never presented as the normal classroom join path.
